Alongside an ongoing deal on AirPods 4 and the rare discount on the black Apple Magic Mouse, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by this Apple Watch Ultra 3 model dropping to one of its best prices to date at nearly $140 off (stock is running low). We also have iPhone 17 Pro/Max units at up to $449 off, a chance to score Apple TV 4K 128GB with Wi‑Fi + Ethernet as low as $139 (now sells for $249 at Apple), and a series of notable accessory discounts: Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID, Anker’s 3-port 160W Smart Display charger, Satechi’s Apple Magic Keyboard alternatives from just $40, and more. Head below for a closer look.

This Apple Watch Ultra 3 model just dropped to one of its best prices to date at nearly $140 off

We are still tracking a host of notable discounts across the Apple Watch Ultra 3 lineup with various configurations at nearly $100 off, but Amazon just dropped the price even further on the Natural Titanium model with the latest Blue Trail Loop – it is now nearly $140 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Natural Titanium Case and the Blue/Bright Blue Trail Loop down at $659.97 shipped. That’s $139 off the regular $799 list price and among the best deals we have tracked on Ultra 3.

Up until Prime Day in late June, just about all models maxed out at the same $99 off we are tracking on most configurations right now. We did see this Natural model with the Blue Trail Loop down at $649 for Prime Day, but are now within just $11 of that all-time low and that is the only time it has ever sold for less than it is right now.

Considering the rest of the models on sale right now are at $99 off, chances are this special price drop isn’t going to last for very long.

Here’s a look at the other configurations marked down right now:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop$799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop now at $660 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)

iPhone 17 Pro Amazon renewed up to $240 off, 17 Pro Max up to $449 off

Alongside some ongoing deals on iPhone 17 Pro Max at up to $449 off the list price courtesy of Woot’s “pristine” condition units, we are also seeing some of the Amazon renewed iPhone 17 Pro models dropping down in price today as well.

With some models now within $11 and $12 of the lowest we have tracked, and Amazon’s renewed refurbished listings still delivering some of the best chances to save on Apple’s latest 17 Pro handsets, we wanted to take a closer look at the best deals available right now:

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,107 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,113 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Silver $1,120 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,262 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,260 (Reg. $1,499)

While Amazon’s 256GB configs aren’t down quite low to warrant a renewed purchase, you can save yourself a couple hundred bucks or so on the 512GB and 1TB models right now.

And here are those aforementioned iPhone 17 Pro Max deals from Woot – these are “PRISTINE and have never been in customer hands” while also arriving with a “test sticker showing 100% battery life and inside a sleek custom black box.”

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (Reg. $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (Reg. $1,999)

Score Apple TV 4K 128GB with Wi‑Fi + Ethernet as low as $139 (Reg. $249 at Apple)

Alongside the current MacBook and iPad lineups, the latest Apple TV 4K models also saw an official price increase. The base model jumped from $129 to $199 while the Apple TV 4K 128GB with Wi‑Fi + Ethernet jumped from $149 to $249. The latter of which is mostly sold out at retail or otherwise now fetching the much higher price tag, but we did spot a live listing over at Sam’s Club asking for $139 on the Apple TV 4K 128GB with Wi‑Fi + Ethernet.

Sam’s Club is now offering the Apple TV 4K 128GB down at $139. While only $10 under the launch price here, deals on Apple TV 4K were already relatively rare and this is now $110 below the new list price.

This deal is for Sam’s Club members, but you can checkout with a guest membership and a 10% surcharge and still make away at well below the price of buying one straight from Apple. Sam’s Club Plus members will get free shipping here.

You can score a regularly $60 Sam’s Club membership for $25 right now as well:

It does appear as though a new Apple TV 4K will be landing this fall, according to reports, but there’s no telling what the price might be there. It doesn’t look like the price increases are going to let up anytime soon and, while it is selling out quick, we are still seeing some Apple gear sitting at pre-price hike rates, much like the Apple TV 4K 128GB we are featuring here today.

Walmart appears to be completely sold out online when it comes to Apple TV 4K, Best Buy’s listings are now reflecting the new higher price tags and so are Target’s. Options for landing the already rarely discounted current-gen machine at the old price are dwindling quickly, and we suspect the new model, if it does arrive later this fall, will hit at a price much closer to the new MSRPs at Apple.

These rare Prime Day deals on Apple Magic Mouse, keyboards, and more are still live from $19

While not all of the best Apple accessories are still live from Prime Day, some of them are, and we are talking about some of the more rare deals on Apple gear. More specifically its base Magic Keyboard, this model with the Touch ID, and the black Magic Mouse. Alongside an ongoing deal on AirPods 4, these three Magic accessories are almost never down at prices this low and we wanted to make sure they are front and center for folks looking to upgrade there Apple input devices before the prices jump back up.

When it comes to Apple Magic accessories, the current-generation iterations with the USB-C charging port, anything in the 20% off range is particularly notable. Deals can be far and few between on this gear, so any sort of savings we can land is welcome. The prices we are featuring here today are the same deals that were live for Amazon’s giant Prime Day bonanza in late June, but after seeing some of them jump back up and down again, we wanted to shine some light here before they potentially jump back up for good (another year, or who knows how long)

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID $145 (Reg. $179)

We are also still tracking some notable deals on the latest 240W Beats USB-C cable (make sure you check out the all-new pink model it just released right here), official iPhone 17 cases, as well as some other notable Apple gear as well:

It’s back: Rare Prime Day price on latest black Apple Magic Mouse now live again

The rare discount on the latest black Apple Magic Mouse is back. Amazon is now serving up an on-page coupon that brings it back down to the Prime Day all-time low.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s Magic Mouse with the black and silvery livery down at $79.99 shipped. The price will automatically drop in the cart (or make sure you have clipped the on-page coupon).

Regularly $99, this is a solid 20% price drop and a rare one at that. Previous to it dropping to this same rate for Amazon’s big 2026 Prime Day festivities, we had only tracked this mouse down this low once, and that was over a year ago. Deals on Magic Mouse can be rare in general and even more so on the black model that has otherwise never dropped below $85.

It just popped up in price early this morning, but Amazon has decided to deliver this on-page coupon to give folks, what might be, a last chance at the Prime Day price before it goes back to its old ways and rarely ever drops under the full $99 list price.

More of this week’s best Apple deals:

Don’t pay the jacked up prices at Apple: M5 MacBook Air is $150 less at Amazon right now

Price hikes have landed on the latest M5 MacBook Air lineup, and there’s no telling when they will let up, if ever. However, folks looking to land a new Air this summer can still avoid paying the newer higher prices at Apple nonetheless, as Amazon does have several configurations at $150 off right now.

Price hikes suck, but it is what it is and if you need a new Air right now Amazon is, at least, offering some price relief here. These are the three configurations you can land at $150 under the newer higher price tags at Apple – we recommend staying away from the others right now until we see the prices come down much lower from the new MSRPs:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)

We did everything we could to highlight these machines once Apple jacked up the prices up, and before those higher prices subsequently landed on Amazon and elsewhere. But if you weren’t ready to pull the trigger and need a machine this summer/this year, you, at least, do not have to pay those prices you see straight from Apple now. You could try to wait this thing out, but there’s really no indication Apple is going to be reverting back to the previous prices at all this year, or ever at this point.
